pages.title: An Echo of Blood
pages.text: Search Pillager Outpost chests for a Crimson Stone.
Worn: increases Blood collection and heals you for part of the damage you deal.$(br2)Forge: greatly reduces Souls requirements; can stack.$(br2)On a jar: slowly produces Blood.
pages.title: Crimson Stone
Blood and Forging
pages.text: Offhand test-tube collection and Blood supplied to a forge by player attacks gain 50%. Placed in the forge instead, this relic halves base Souls requirements.

pages.title: A Slowly Filling Jar
pages.text: Use a Crimson Stone on an empty or Blood-filled jar. It produces 3 Blood every 5 seconds and pauses when full. Sneak-use an empty hand to retrieve the relic; breaking the jar also returns it.
